title: The exit liveness tests (worker watchdog and anti-rug wall-clock bound) replace the hung operation with a fake, so they prove the caller is freed but cannot see that the hung sell still holds the wallet nonce lock and blocks every later exit

evidence.note: Test 2 "bot stays alive": the sell executor is replaced by _setSellExecutorForTesting; the hung first item is a bare never-resolving promise that takes no lock, so the second item "starts" and the test passes
executeFullSell is a vi.fn that never resolves; the test asserts only that triggerAntiRugExit resolves false after the budget
Promise.race([op(), budget]) frees the awaiting caller only; op() keeps running
withTimeout around executeFullSell: same, the inner sell is not cancelled
public-fallback swap and its stx.wait() run inside withNonceLock(ctx.wallet.address); a wait that never settles keeps the lock
every later op for the wallet is chained after the prior one settles
realSellExecutor is executeFullSell: the production second exit waits inside its own withNonceLock behind the hung first one

sibling_sites_checked: Other tests of the watchdog and the anti-rug bound: bot/watchdog.test.ts Tests 1, 3, 4 exercise the real wrapper with a never-resolving op (correct for what they claim); exitEngine/exitWorker.test.ts and exitEngine/pollTelemetry.test.ts also substitute the executor; exitEngine/exitWorkerRealPath.test.ts drives the real executor but every wait() resolves immediately. No unit test combines a never-settling wait inside withNonceLock with a second same-wallet exit.
severity_rationale: S2 by the test rubric: the tests claim the bot "stays alive" and the stuck position "will retry", while the registered S1s AUD-EXIT-009 and AUD-TX-002 (a never-settling wait inside the wallet lock blocks every later tx) and AUD-ANTIRUG-004 (a timed-out anti-rug escape is never retried) pass them green.
recommendation: Phase 28: drive the real executeFullSell through the worker with a same-wallet tx whose wait() never settles, then enqueue a second exit for the same wallet and assert whether it signs within the budget (it does not today: RED for AUD-EXIT-009). For the anti-rug bound, assert what happens to the position after the timeout (held, failed-held, retried) instead of only the caller result.
affected_cases: watchdog.test.ts: processes the next queued exit after the first submit is watchdog-aborted
antiRugBounded.test.ts: a STALLED anti-rug submit is FREED by the budget — triggerAntiRugExit resolves (does not hang)
antiRugBounded.test.ts: a timed-out anti-rug exit still records toward the circuit breaker (a consumed trigger slot)
escaped_regression: Today's code already escapes: an exit whose stx.wait() at src/exitEngine.ts:556 never settles keeps the wallet lock, and the next queued exit for that wallet never signs, while watchdog Test 2 stays green because its fake executor takes no lock. A concrete code change that also stays green: re-add an outer withNonceLock around realSellExecutor at src/exitEngine.ts:1281-1282 (the CR-01 shape, which deadlocks every worker exit): watchdog Test 2 never runs realSellExecutor.
